## Historical premise (superseded)
This item was promoted from the pm-mpbb DX ledger on 2026-07-11, when the pm-a22j baseline gate opened. Its original proposal treated `pm contracts --summary` followed by `pm next` as the cheapest complete cold start. That proposal is retained in immutable history, but later replay measurement disproved it as the canonical workflow.

## Current measured contract
The canonical read-only orientation is one intent-routed call: `pm context --for orient`. The fixed 101-item replay measured it at 1,055 estimated tokens, versus 2,293 for the historical four-read sequence and 4,798 for contracts plus next. Human docs and generated guidance must name the measured winner and the release gate must fail if a more expensive protocol becomes canonical.

## Scope
Documentation and instruction templates only: AGENTS.md, the README agent section, the Agent Guide, and generated Claude/Codex/ChatGPT-aligned guidance consume the same measured protocol. Cite the agent-task replay baseline as evidence.

## Constraint
No new top-level commands. Preserve the original premise in append-only history while keeping live item metadata aligned with the measured contract.
